eventos.title: The Spell Council
eventos.texto_original: The Spell Council has returned in force, aware that you allowed the Mad Mage to remain free. Powerful elemental magic crackles around them as they prepare for battle. "So, you have chosen oblivion."

options.name: Fight
options.desc: Whose oblivion will be determined.

eventos.title: Torn Portrait
eventos.texto_original: The yearning ghost extends her hand pleading for help.

options.name: Reach
options.desc: You reach out to the ghost. Gain [o1a1_status].

actions.text:
You reach out, but your hand passes through cold air. Memories flood your mind and longing fills your heart.

You gain [o1a1_status].

options.name: Leave
options.desc: The chill in the air causes you to hesitate. You leave without helping.

actions.text: You leave, but the ghost's disappointment haunts your dreams.

eventos.title: Tornado!
eventos.texto_original: A Tornado, a monstrous titan of air and fury, touches down with a ferocity that makes the very earth beneath you shudder. It is a terrifying spectacle, an embodiment of nature's raw, uncontrollable power.   The world becomes a maelic whirlwind of chaos. The tornado's winds howl like banshees, pulling at you with the inexorable force of a monstrous vortex. Debris spins in a deadly dance around the twister's base, and you know you have but moments to react.

options.name: React
options.desc: Grab onto whatever you can and hold on tight.

actions.text:
Your eyes dart around, searching for anything you can use to anchor yourself against the storm's ravenous pull. Your heart pounds in your chest, each beat a second closer to oblivion. Spotting a large, jagged rock nearby, you launch yourself towards it, throwing your arms around the base.

Every gust threatens to pry you loose, to pull you into the tornado's merciless whirl. Yet, you hold on, amidst the fury of the storm.

eventos.title: Transcendence
eventos.texto_original: Underneath a majestic cherry blossom tree, an old man stands, wreathed in a shower of falling blossoms. His eyes are closed, his face calm and peaceful, reflecting an inner tranquility that seems to permeate the very air around him.   The man is old, his skin lined like a well-weathered parchment, and a silver mustache flows down to his chest. His attire is simple, but it had a quality of elegance and humility. It is clear that he is a man who has distilled the essence of his life to the simple act of existence.  As you approach, the old man opens his eyes, those clear orbs holding depths of wisdom and understanding. His gaze scans you, taking in the battle-worn armor, the well-used weapons, the aura of determination and purpose. It is a look that seems to bypass the physical, reaching to the core of your being.  "You carry the weight of the world on your shoulders, young one," the old man says softly, his voice a gentle murmur amid the rustling cherry blossoms. "You strive and struggle, battling forces beyond your control. But I say to you: even the mightiest tree needs time to rest and grow."   He gestures to the cherry blossom tree above you. "Look at these blossoms. They do not strive, do not battle. They simply are. They exist, beautiful in their transience. They do not fear their fall, for they know it is but a part of their journey."   He turns his gaze back to you, a soft smile playing on his lips. "Rest here, warrior. Set aside your worldly concerns. In the silence of the heart, free from the clamor of material pursuits, you will find your true purpose."

options.name: Meditate
options.desc: You calm your mind seeking wisdom.

actions.text:
You draw breaths slowly, matching the rhythm to the whisper of the breeze through the cherry blossoms. The world outside begins to fade, replaced by the darkness behind your eyelids. But it isn't an oppressive darkness, more like a canvas waiting to be painted upon.

Then, subtly, you feel something within you shift, like a door opening or a river changing its course. Your mind is suddenly filled with a sense of vastness, like you are floating in an endless sea or standing atop a towering peak. It is a quietude that whispers of infinity, a tranquil pool that reflects the universe.

options.name: Leave
options.desc: You quite like your earthly possessions. You leave unable to give up the world.

eventos.title: Treasure Chest
eventos.texto_original: A massive ornate chest gleams in front of you.

eventos.title: Treasure Chest
eventos.texto_original: You discover a large Treasure Chest, wrought of richly grained wood and bands of intricately engraved bronze.  It appears to have been forgotten, its surface is dusted with the quiet neglect of time. A glint of promise, of rich rewards held within.

options.name: Open
options.desc: Open the chest.

actions.text:
With cautious excitement, you approach, reaching out to lift its heavy lid.  Your fingers brush over the cool bronze lock. But the moment your hand makes contact, the world blurs into a nightmare.

The wood groans and twists, while the bronze bands open revealing a grotesque, gaping maw. It is not a chest, but a Mimic, a deadly creature adept at luring in unwary adventurers.

options.name: Leave
options.desc: You're not in it for the treasure.

eventos.title: Treasure Chest
eventos.texto_original: A massive ornate chest gleams in front of you.

eventos.title: Treasure Hunter
eventos.texto_original: Your path crosses with another adventurer, a treasure hunter of sorts. He is an older man, his eyes gleaming with an avid curiosity that belies his age, hunched over what seems to be a collection of parchment and maps spread out on a makeshift wooden table.  "Hero!" he greets, his voice coarse but spirited. "You appear just in time. I am on the verge of a great discovery. The Treasure of Moltendunn, the spoils of a legendary kingdom, lost for countless generations. This map," he points at the worn parchment, "may just hold the key."

options.name: Help
options.desc: Lend your aid to the old treasure hunter.

actions.text:
Intrigued, you hunch over the map, tracing the faded symbols and cryptic inscriptions that dance across its surface.

Hours turn into days as you pour over the map, drawing on the treasure hunter's knowledge and your keen intellect.  Your efforts are rewarded as your finger traces a hidden path leading to a point yet unexplored. "Here!" you exclaim, your voice echoing in the camp. "The path... It was hidden in plain sight!"

options.name: Leave
options.desc: You're not interested in chasing treasure this time.

eventos.title: Unidentified Remains
eventos.texto_original: Skeletal remains, unceremoniously scattered, speak of a fate long forgotten. The bones are dry and brittle, tattered fragments of clothing still clinging to them. The skull, half-buried in the sand, stares blankly, an empty testimony of an unknown life cut short.

options.name: Search
options.desc: Look for anything useful.

actions.text: As you sift through the soil, your fingertips brush against something metallic...

eventos.title: What Lurks
eventos.texto_original: In the parched, wind-swept land of Wyrmrest Desert, a great monstrosity mars the horizon. The grotesque corpse of a colossal ogre, every inch of its leathery hide etched with deep, bloody gashes. Even from a distance, the stench of death washes over you, a fetid miasma that permeates the air, replacing the usual dry desert scent with a noxious, gut-churning odor.

options.name: Investigate
options.desc: Give in to your curiosity and examine the Ogre closer.

actions.text:
Suddenly, a movement catches your eye. The ogre's enormous form jerks, then begins sinking into the sand. A giant, armored claw reaches up from the earth, pulling the lifeless bulk down with alarming strength.

Dread settles in the pit of your stomach as the sands around you begin to churn. A low rumble, a vibration beneath your boots - you were not alone. An armored behemoth erupts from the sand, its body encased in a menacing carapace of spikes. Towering over you, the beast stands hunched, its long spiked tail thrashing restlessly. Its head is a horrifying display of jagged spikes and gnashing mandibles.

options.name: Flee
options.desc: Run from whatever did this.

actions.text: Without another glance at the deceased ogre, you turn and run, each stride kicking up small clouds of desert sand.

eventos.title: Witch's Cauldron
eventos.texto_original: In the heart of the Sunken Swamp, you find a small clearing where an Ancient Hag squats, her skeletal figure hunched over a bubbling cauldron. The container hisses and sputters, spewing a sickly green concoction that spatters onto the surrounding soil, instantly shriveling any plant life it touches.   The putrid odor is nearly unbearable. It permeates the air, a malodorous blend of swamp water, rot, and something undefinably sour. As the smell reaches you, a wave of revulsion washes over you, your stomach lurches in protest. You can taste the bile rising in your throat.   You try to turn away but you cannot. Your hand, seemingly of its own volition, stretches out towards the cauldron. You try to pull back, to wrench your hand away from the vile brew, but it moves as if bewitched, resisting your will. Your fingers skim the surface of the seething liquid, scooping up a handful. You watch in wide-eyed horror as your possessed hands bring the potion to your lips.   The hag cackles in delight, her voice a rasping echo that bounces off the gnarled tree trunks. Her eyes, two pinpricks of cruel light in her wrinkled visage, gleam with mirth and malice.

options.name: Resist
options.desc: Fight against the witch's enchantment.

actions.text:
With a roar of defiance, you kick over the cauldron. The foul mixture sizzles upon the earth, steam rising as it soakes into the swamp. You stagger back, gasping, your head spinning as you fight to regain your footing.


When you finally look up, the hag is gone. The only trace of her is the echoing laughter that dances among the trees, chilling your spine even as relief washes over you.

eventos.title: Witch's Pyre
eventos.texto_original: A smoldering pyre blazes amidst the damp moss and hanging vines of the swamp, its feral light casting long, twisted shadows across the gloom. The sight is as fascinating as it is harrowing.   The fire dances and writhes, a serpent set ablaze, consuming all that is offered to it. All, save for the spectral figure at its heart. The witch, it seems, is not affected by the flames. She is as still as stone, a chilling silhouette amidst the raging inferno.  Your gaze locks with the witch's, and you find yourself entrapped by her stare. Her eyes, gleaming coals in the firelight, seem to bore into your very soul.  Was it your imagination, or has she been staring at you all along?

options.name: Stay
options.desc: Watch as the Pyre burns low.

actions.text:
You stay rooted on the spot, watching the pyre burn low, the witch’s image fading with the dying embers. The blaze offers no warmth, the humid swamp air seeing to that. Yet, beads of perspiration trickle down your forehead, an uncanny counter to the chill that has taken root in your bones.

With a trembling hand, you reach up to wipe away the sweat. As you pull your hand back, your heart clenches. Glistening in the firelight on your palm is not the clear liquid of sweat, but the deep, haunting crimson of blood.

options.name: Run
options.desc: You've lost your nerve.

actions.text: Doubts and fear swirl within you, overwhelming your senses until your legs move on their own accord. You are fleeing. Fleeing from the horrifying spectacle, the witch's laughter ringing in your ears, mocking you.

eventos.texto_original: The yearning ghost extends her hand pleading for help.

You reach out, but your hand passes through cold air. Memories flood your mind and longing fills your heart.

You gain [o1a1_status].

actions.text: You leave, but the ghost's disappointment haunts your dreams.

eventos.title: Wrath of the Righteous
eventos.texto_original: Through the arched passageways and shadowed halls of this castle, you find yourself standing before a figure who appears to be hewn from radiance itself. A Paladin, clad in armor of brilliant light, that casts the dreary surroundings into stark relief. His presence is a beacon of hope in the midst of such an accursed place.  "This kingdom," he begins, gesturing to the darkened tapestries and ominous statues lining the corridors, "was once a place of joy, a place where valor met prosperity and nobility met humility. But now..." His gaze falls, his expression sorrowful. The luminous light surrounding him seems to dim, the sadness is almost palpable. "Now, this castle is but a mockery of its past, its people cursed, its glory lost."  "At the heart of it all is <rainb>The Jester</rainb>, our former king transformed into a vile demon. He is the embodiment of the darkness that has seeped into the heart of our kingdom, the puppet master who pulls the strings of this grim performance."  His plea resonates in the chilly air, a desperate call to arms. "Will you aid us, adventurer? Will you deliver us from the grip of this monstrous farce, and bring an end to our torment?"

options.name: Accept
options.desc: Vow to vanquish this evil.

actions.text: The old paladin reaches forward, his armored hand heavy with years of servitude, and clasps you in a grip firm with gratitude and resolve. "Let this end."

options.name: Decline
options.desc: Tis a noble quest, but you cannot accept it now.

actions.text: The paladin nods, the radiance around him dimming slightly. His face remains stoic, but there is a quiet sadness in his gaze that speaks volumes. "I understand, wanderer," he says, his voice carrying a note of resignation. "We all have our paths to follow, our obligations to meet."

eventos.title: Wrath of the Righteous
eventos.texto_original: A noble Paladin stands before you, wreathed in holy light.  "Hold, travelers. This once glorious kingdom and it's citizens have been twisted into monstrous versions of themselves. Their foolish King allowed evil to take hold of his court."  "I have spent my life seeking an end to it's corruption, to undo what this treacherous King has done, but there is one I cannot vanquish."   "<violet>The Lady of the Well</violet> was once a princess fair and true. Now she is the very shadow of evil, terrorizing the forests at night."   "Bring me her Shadow-drenched Heart, and we will bring an end to this evil for good."

options.name: Accept
options.desc: Vow to vanquish this evil.

actions.text: You agree to help and he clasps your hand in fellowship. "Follow the light, my friend."

options.name: Decline
options.desc: Tis' a noble quest, but you cannot accept it now.

actions.text:
The Paladin nods in understanding.

"This burden of this evil is not yours to bear. Follow the light, my friend."

eventos.title: Yours or Mine
eventos.texto_original: On approach, you find the enemy quite distracted. A thief's dream!

options.name: Steal
options.desc: Covertly take as many valuables as you can.

actions.text: Your smile widens as you examine your hard-earned possessions. They didn't notice a thing.
